title: The Funeral Verse Is Passive. Its Only Twin Isn't.
excerpt: The rare root behind "drawn away" (zuhziha) appears only twice in the Quran: denied in the active voice at 2:96 (a lifespan cannot budge you from punishment), granted in the passive voice at 3:185 (the funeral verse). One word, two verses, one complete answer to who actually does the rescuing.
seo_title: Why Is 3:185 in the Passive Voice? Quran's Rare Zahzaha Root
seo_description: The root behind "drawn away from the Fire" in Quran 3:185 appears only once more, in 2:96 — in the active voice, and denied. A corpus-verified reading of the Quran's only voice-flip on rescue from punishment.
